You're the best <name job>

yet!
Welcome.

Let me explain the
mission.

You are to secure a route
to the deepest part of
the underground ruins.

Simply put, get to the
bottom of the ruins.

However, you'll need to
eliminate all enemies
that block your way.

A teleporter has already
been set up to take you
to the ruins entry point.

You can get there
directly from the city.

I fear there may still

down there.

The Lab seems to have
deciphered the text from
those readings you took

from the stone relics
earlier.

According to their
analysis, it says:

"Light makes darkness,
a pair exists, but its
existence is dubious."

"Reincarnation is
infinite. The rules
are laid."

"It must be sealed.
MUUT DITTS POUMN"...

That's what they say,
at least.

What could it mean,
though, I wonder?

Keep this quiet, but
high-density, abnormal
photons have been

detected in those ruins,
along with those strange,
new enemies.

What in the world could
possibly be down there?

It wasn't a coincidence
that the Pioneer Project
targeted Ragol.

We've linked our current
information with our
older discoveries.

About 20 or so years ago,
a meteorite fell on our
homeworld.

Cells from an alien life
were found, and those
cells had a signature

quite similar to our
own recent photon energy
sources.

Photon energy wasn't
fully understood back
then, so top scientists

were brought in to see
if they could unlock 
its secrets.

That was when our world
began to die, and a large
scale exodus was planned.

and their probes found
Ragol, where they could
continue their research.

If we'd never discovered
photon energy, this never
would have happened.

And the wars that ravaged
our homeworld probably
wouldn't have happened.

But it's too late to
complain about that
now…
You defeated all enemies!
